answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 13 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 940 identities costs 940 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the grove here is verification, the vine of cost is what stops the farm, and the signal of the record keeps every claim checkable.
